demo.code:
You:   long BTC 100x with $150 on papertrade, pay with my ETH on Base
Bankr: Long BTC on Papertrade (real USDC): $150 margin at 100x = $15,000
       position. Entry ~$112,840, liquidation ~$111,770 (-0.95%).
       Funded from ~0.061 ETH on Base, converted to USDC and sent to
       Papertrade (usually under a minute). No open fee, no funding; a
       win pays an impact haircut, Papertrade's 2% and Bankr's 1%.
       A liquidation loses the whole $150. Reply yes to place it.
You:   yes
Bankr: Opened a long on BTC at 100x. Margin $150, entry $112,846,
       liquidation $111,774. Ask me to close it any time.
You:   take profit at $115,000, stop loss at $112,100
Bankr: Set on your BTC long: take-profit $115,000 (+1.9%), stop-loss
       $112,100 (-0.7%, 0.29% inside liquidation). When one is hit, I
       close the whole position at market a few seconds later.
       Best-effort: the fill can be worse than the level, nothing
       closes while Bankr or Papertrade is down or paused, and a
       liquidation can still come first.

— later —
Bankr: Your stop-loss at $112,100 was hit. Closed your BTC long at
       $112,080: -$102. The loss minted PAPER, and I staked it for you:
       staked PAPER earns a share of Papertrade's USDC.

See your account, PAPER staking, positions with their TP/SL and
history at bankr.bot/papertrade.

setup: Install the skill with the button below — Bankr's Papertrade tools work without it; the skill adds the venue's rules and risks
Hold USDC or another token (such as ETH on Base) in your Bankr wallet; one preview covers funding Papertrade and opening the trade (first deposit 11.20 USDC or more)
Say: "long BTC 100x with $150 on papertrade" — you get a preview with the liquidation price, then reply yes. Leverage goes up to 1000x; above 100x Bankr leads with how small a move liquidates it

Add a take-profit or stop-loss on the open or later ("set a stop-loss on my papertrade BTC at $110,000"). Bankr runs them and closes the whole position at market a few seconds after a level is hit. They're best-effort, and a stop-loss must sit at least 0.25% inside the liquidation price, so very high leverage can't have one (above roughly 220x when set on the open, about 250x once the position is open); a take-profit still works
Every losing trade mints PAPER and Bankr stakes it for you to earn USDC; see your account, PAPER staking, positions with their take-profit and stop-loss, and history at https://bankr.bot/papertrade
Real money: a liquidation takes the whole margin, and winnings the pool can't pay wait in a queue. Your wallet's Security limits apply to every trade
